# Delight Rabbit Farm

> Rwanda's trusted purebred rabbit farm (Rwamagana, Eastern Province, Rwanda), serving Kigali and farmers nationwide with pedigreed breeding stock, rabbit meat, formulated rabbit feed pellets, hay & forage, artificial insemination (rabbit semen), hands-on rabbit farming training, and commercial farm consultancy.

## Business Details
- **Name:** Delight Rabbit Farm
- **Location:** Rwamagana, Eastern Province, Rwanda (serving Kigali and all provinces across Rwanda)
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +250 788 448 889 (https://wa.me/250788448889)
- **Email:** info@delightrabbitfarm.rw
- **YouTube:** https://www.youtube.com/@Delightrabbit
- **Business Hours:** Monday–Friday 09:00 AM–07:00 PM; Saturday 09:00 AM–12:00 PM; Sunday Closed
- **Experience:** 10+ years, 5,000+ purebred rabbits supplied, 250+ farmers trained, 12 purebred breeds

## Purebred Rabbit Breeds Available
- **New Zealand White:** Docile, fast-growing, high meat yield, ideal for commercial meat production.
- **Californian White:** Active, hardy, excellent maternal instincts.
- **Flemish Giant:** Large-frame "gentle giant" breed.
- **Dutch:** Gentle, prolific, easy to manage.
- **Angola:** Hardy, reliable breeders suited to Rwandan climate.
- **Checkered Giant:** Large, active foragers.

## Services & Pages
- [Home](https://delightrabbitfarm.rw/): Overview of Delight Rabbit Farm, breeds, farm gallery, and contact form.
- [Breeding Rabbits](https://delightrabbitfarm.rw/service-breeding.html): Pedigreed bucks, does, weaned kits, and starter trios (1 buck + 2 does) with documented lineage and health guarantees.
- [Rabbit Farming Training](https://delightrabbitfarm.rw/service-training.html): Hands-on courses in rabbitry husbandry, housing, feeding, breeding cycles, disease prevention, and agribusiness profitability.
- [Rabbit Semen & Genetics](https://delightrabbitfarm.rw/service-semen.html): High-viability purebred buck semen (>85% active motility) and artificial insemination (AI) support for rapid genetic improvement.
- [Fresh Rabbit Meat](https://delightrabbitfarm.rw/service-meat.html): Hygienically processed, high-protein, low-cholesterol rabbit meat delivered cold to households, restaurants, and hotels in Kigali and across Rwanda.
- [Rabbit Feed Pellets](https://delightrabbitfarm.rw/service-pellets.html): Balanced, nutritious rabbit feed pellets (10kg, 25kg, 50kg bags) formulated for growers, breeding does, and kits.
- [Hay & Forage](https://delightrabbitfarm.rw/service-forage.html): Dust- and mold-free sun-cured Rhodes grass, Timothy, and Alfalfa hay bales for digestive and dental health.
- [Farm Consultancy & Hutch Design](https://delightrabbitfarm.rw/service-consultancy.html): Turnkey commercial rabbitry setup, multi-tier galvanized cage engineering, biosecurity protocols, and financial planning.

## Common Questions
- **Where can I buy purebred rabbits in Rwanda?** Delight Rabbit Farm in Rwamagana supplies pedigreed New Zealand White, Californian White, Flemish Giant, Checkered Giant, Dutch, and Angola breeding rabbits with nationwide delivery, including Kigali.
- **Does Delight Rabbit Farm train new rabbit farmers?** Yes, Delight Rabbit Farm offers practical, hands-on rabbit farming training for beginners and commercial investors, plus ongoing farm consultancy.
- **Can I order fresh rabbit meat or rabbit feed in Kigali?** Yes, Delight Rabbit Farm supplies fresh dressed rabbit meat, balanced rabbit feed pellets, and sun-cured hay bales to Kigali and across Rwanda.
